## 1. Executive Summary

A comprehensive, production-grade End-to-End (E2E) test suite has been designed, implemented, and verified across all core architectural layers and pedagogical requirements of the Pharmacy Education Platform.

In strict adherence to **Dual Track** test engineering principles:
- **No Facade or Dummy Tests**: Every assertion verifies genuine DOM state, mathematical calculations, computed styles, CSS layout attributes (`dir="rtl"`, `lang="tr"`), localized text matching Turkish/Arabic/English rules, authentic `localStorage` progress persistence, and automated WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility checks.
- **Progressive Testability**: All tests operate against the running client application (`vite preview` on port 4173) with realistic user interactions.
- **Comprehensive 4-Tier Matrix + Axe-Core Auditing**: Totaling **88 unique test cases** per browser project (**352 total test executions** across the 4 configured Playwright viewports).

## 3. Playwright Multi-Viewport Matrix

Configured in `playwright.config.ts` to ensure cross-device and cross-cultural responsiveness:

1. **`desktop-brave-shields-default`**:
   - Engine: Chromium (`channel: 'chrome'`)
   - Viewport: `1280 x 720` (Desktop widescreen)
   - Locale: `tr-TR`
   - Purpose: Primary desktop baseline testing Turkish default experience with Brave Shields compatibility.
2. **`mobile-chrome-tr`**:
   - Device: `Pixel 5` emulation
   - Viewport: `393 x 851`
   - Locale: `tr-TR`
   - Purpose: Verifies mobile responsive layouts, sticky bottom bars, touch hit targets (>=44x44px), and compact progress steppers.
3. **`mobile-safari-ar`**:
   - Device: `iPhone 13` emulation
   - Viewport: `390 x 844`
   - Locale: `ar-EG`
   - Direction: `rtl`
   - Purpose: Verifies Arabic typography (Cairo/Amiri font stack), Special Arabic Rule dual-terms, RTL flow, and LTR formula isolation on mobile iOS.
4. **`tablet-safari`**:
   - Device: `iPad Mini` emulation
   - Viewport: `768 x 1024`
   - Locale: `en-US`
   - Purpose: Verifies medium-viewport two-column curriculum grids, tablet drawer interactions, and modal centering.

## 4. Test Runner Commands

All commands are executed from the project root directory:
`C:\Users\hp\.gemini\antigravity\worktrees\valiant-raman\pharmacy_education_platform_setup\`

### Running the Suites

```bash
# 1. Run all E2E test suites on default desktop project
npx playwright test --project=desktop-brave-shields-default

# 2. Run Tier 1 Feature Coverage suite (36 tests)
npx playwright test e2e/tier1-features.spec.ts --project=desktop-brave-shields-default

# 3. Run Tier 2 Boundary & Corner Cases suite (26 tests)
npx playwright test e2e/tier2-boundaries.spec.ts --project=desktop-brave-shields-default

# 4. Run Tier 3 Pairwise Combinations suite (8 tests)
npx playwright test e2e/tier3-combinations.spec.ts --project=desktop-brave-shields-default

# 5. Run Tier 4 Real-World Student Scenarios (5 tests)
npx playwright test e2e/tier4-scenarios.spec.ts --project=desktop-brave-shields-default

# 6. Run Axe-Core Automated Accessibility Audit (13 tests)
npx playwright test e2e/a11y-audit.spec.ts --project=desktop-brave-shields-default

# 7. Run across all viewports (Desktop, Mobile TR, Mobile AR, Tablet)
npx playwright test

# 8. Run in headed interactive mode
npx playwright test --headed

# 9. View interactive HTML test report
npx playwright show-report
```

## 5. Requirement Verification Checklist (R1 – R7)

### R1: Dual-Language Foundations & Special Arabic Rule
- [x] **Primary Default Turkish (`tr`)**: Platform loads in Turkish (`<html lang="tr">`) without English flashes.
- [x] **Zero Untranslated Template Keys**: Catalog, pricing, navigation, badges, and modals contain zero raw untranslated placeholders.
- [x] **Canonical Discipline Naming**: Course A is strictly named *"Farmasötik Kimya"* (never colloquial *"Eczacılık Kimyası"*).
- [x] **Special Arabic Rule Compliance**: When Arabic locale is active, pharmacological and medicinal chemistry terms preserve Latin/English terms in parentheses (e.g., `مناهض تنافسي (Competitive Antagonist)`, `النشاط الديناميكي الحراري (Thermodynamic Activity)`).
- [x] **LTR Isolation for Chemical/Math Formulas**: Formulas (`a = Pt / P0`, `log(1/C)`) and chemical structures render with explicit `dir="ltr"` isolation within RTL containers.

### R2: Bidirectional Mirroring & Layout Consistency
- [x] **Automatic `dir="rtl"` Activation**: Switching to Arabic immediately updates `<html dir="rtl">`.
- [x] **Flex/Grid Direction Inversion**: Navigation items, cards, breadcrumb arrows, and stats badges mirror smoothly to right-to-left layout.
- [x] **Chevron & Icon Inversion**: Back buttons and directional navigation chevrons mirror appropriately (`rtl:rotate-180`).
- [x] **Arabic Typography Stack**: Arabic text renders using `Cairo` and `Amiri` font families with proper line heights.

### R3: High-Contrast Academic Theme System
- [x] **Academic Midnight Slate Theme**: Dark mode activates `#0F172A` / `#1E293B` backgrounds with high-contrast `#F8FAFC` typography and `#F59E0B` amber accents.
- [x] **Neobrutalist Borders & Shadows**: 2px/3px solid borders (`border-black` / `border-slate-700`) and distinct hard-edge drop shadows (`shadow-neo`).
- [x] **Contrast Ratio Compliance**: Text and interactive elements meet or exceed WCAG 2.1 AA 4.5:1 ratio.
- [x] **Zero Flash of Unstyled Content (FOUC)**: Theme and locale state hydrate synchronously from `localStorage`.

### R4: Interactive Pedagogical Simulation Widgets
- [x] **Ferguson Principle Simulator**: Dynamic slider modulating relative saturation ($a = P_t / P_0$ or $S_t / S_0$) with live calculation, thermodynamic threshold demarcation ($a = 0.01 - 1.0$), and classification feedback.
- [x] **Dose-Response Curve**: Pharmacodynamic simulation illustrating agonist vs competitive/non-competitive antagonist shifts ($E_{max}$ and $EC_{50}$).
- [x] **1-Compartment PK Simulator**: Interactive clearance, volume of distribution ($V_d$), elimination rate ($k_e$), half-life ($t_{1/2}$), and multiple dosing regimens.
- [x] **Mathematical Boundaries**: Cleanly handles boundary conditions ($a = 0.00$, $a = 1.00$, $Pt = P0$) without `NaN`, Infinity, or division by zero.

### R5: 12-Stage Concept Mastery & Predict-Then-Reveal
- [x] **10-Step Progress Stepper**: Interactive step dots with visual state transitions (unvisited, active, completed).
- [x] **Predict-Then-Reveal Commitment**: Forces students to commit a prediction hypothesis before revealing the correct biophysical model and scientific rationale.
- [x] **Diagnostic Feedback**: Highlights misconceptions immediately upon hypothesis reveal.
- [x] **Recap & Synthesis (Step 10)**: Awards 50 XP, maintains daily streaks, and enqueues 3 spaced review flashcards into Leitner Box 1.

### R6: Cardless Free Preview & Trial Model
- [x] **Lessons 1 & 2 Free Forever**: Deep navigation to Lesson 1 and Lesson 2 opens immediately without paywalls or credit card requirements.
- [x] **Paywall Trigger on Locked Lessons**: Navigating to Lesson 3+ immediately mounts the PaywallModal for unauthenticated/free students.
- [x] **One-Click Cardless Trial**: Students can activate a 7-day all-access trial without entering billing info.
- [x] **Downgrade Preservation**: Trial expiration downgrades access to free preview while retaining 100% of accumulated XP and Leitner review flashcards.

### R7: Turkish Lira Freemium Pricing Matrix
- [x] **Accurate Currency Display**: All tiers clearly priced in Turkish Lira using the `₺` symbol and proper Turkish number formatting.
- [x] **Semester Pass**: `₺850` (single course, 5-month semester access).
- [x] **Annual Pass**: `₺1,400` (single course, 12-month access).
- [x] **Dual Bundle**: `₺2,200` (Course A: Farmasötik Kimya + Course B: Farmakoloji full annual access).
